_comment: The case PLAN.md §7.2 flags for human review: energyConfig.gas is ENABLED
and gasKwh is nonzero on a system whose field is named kWh but almost
certainly is not kWh. The row is still written verbatim as metric=kwh_day
-- guessing a therm->kWh conversion would be inventing data -- and a WARN
is logged. A gas system also enables fangas, so both appear here.
reheat is enabled but reports zeros: an enabled component's zero IS a
measurement and must be recorded (cardinal rule 2), unlike a disabled
component's, which must not exist at all.
